t: This module extends and withdraws a row of blocks (from the router's buffer) in the module's configured direction.$(p)By default, the module extends blocks when the router has a redstone signal, and withdraws them when the router has no signal, but a Redstone Enhancement can be added to the module to customise this behaviour.
这个模块会沿着模块设定的方向，伸出并收回一排来自路由器缓冲区的方块。$(p)默认情况下，当路由器有红石信号时模块会伸出方块，而在没有红石信号时收回；不过你也可以给模块添加红石增强件来自定义这种行为。

Using this module, it's possible to build large extending bridges and doorways. (If you ever used the Tinker's Drawbridge from the Tinker's Mechworks mod in 1.7.10, the functionality will be familiar).$(li)See also the $(l:upgrades/camouflage)Camouflage Upgrade/$, which may be useful to hide the router.$(li)The default range (i.e. number of blocks which can be placed) is 12, but this can be increased up to 24 with $(l:augments/range_up)Range Up Augments/$.

使用这个模块，你可以建造大型可伸缩桥梁和门道。（如果你曾在 1.7.10 中使用过 Tinker's Mechworks 模组里的 Tinker's Drawbridge，那么这个功能你会很熟悉。）$(li)另请参阅$(l:upgrades/camouflage)伪装升级/$，它可能有助于隐藏路由器。$(li)默认范围（即可放置的方块数量）为 12，但可通过$(l:augments/range_up)范围升级拓展/$提高到 24。

$(li)If you change the module's direction while it has blocks extended, you may get the router a little confused. In this case, breaking and replacing the router will help.$(li)If you break the router while blocks are extended, it won't remember that, and you'll need to manually remove those blocks.
$(li)如果你在模块已伸出方块时修改它的方向，可能会让路由器有点“搞不清状况”。遇到这种情况时，破坏并重新放置路由器会有帮助。$(li)如果你在方块伸出时破坏了路由器，它不会记住这些方块的状态，你需要手动将那些方块移除。

$(li)If you have multiple routers together with Extruder Modules installed (e.g. for a wide door or bridge), you may find the $(l:upgrades/sync)Sync Upgrade/$ useful to ensure they all run on the same tick.$(li)The Extruder (like the $(l:modules/placer)Placer/$) can also plant crop seeds on farmland, and cocoa beans on an adjacent jungle log.
$(li)若你将多个安装了造桥模块的路由器并排布置（例如用于建造宽幅门或桥梁），那么$(l:upgrades/sync)同步升级/$将十分有用，可确保它们全部在同一游戏刻运行。$(li)造桥模块（与$(l:modules/placer)放置器/$类似）还能在耕地中播种作物种子，并在相邻的丛林原木上种植可可豆。

It is important to note that the $(l:modules/breaker)Breaker Module/$ used to craft this module will transfer its harvest level (and enchantments) to this module. So if you want your Extruder Module to be able to break $(item)Obsidian/$, for example, make sure you use a Breaker Module crafted with a $(item)Diamond Pickaxe/$!
需要特别注意的是，用于合成该模块的$(l:modules/breaker)破坏模块/$会把它的挖掘等级（以及附魔）一并继承给这个模块。所以，例如如果你想让造桥模块能够破坏$(item)黑曜石/$，请务必使用由$(item)钻石镐/$合成的破坏模块！
